title: Postpartum Hemorrhage
sources: Critical Vector — OB Pocket Guide: Postpartum Hemorrhage (ACOG 2023)
ACOG Practice Bulletin 183 / reaffirmed; WOMAN trial (TXA, Lancet 2017); FIGO PPH guidance

changelog.change: Initial entry — the staged response, the 4 Ts, the uterotonic ladder with doses and contraindications, TXA, and balloon tamponade.

summary: PPH = cumulative blood loss ≥ 1000 mL, OR any blood loss with signs of hypovolaemia, within 24 h of delivery. Leading cause of maternal mortality worldwide. Work the 4 Ts — Tone (80%), Trauma, Tissue, Thrombin — while escalating the staged response.

rows: 500–999 mL (or ongoing)
Alert the team; fundal massage; oxytocin infusion; bimanual uterine compression PRN; assess tone and inspect for lacerations; IV access, T&S
≥ 1000 mL or unstable
Add a SECOND uterotonic + TXA 1 g IV; 2× large-bore IV; STAT CBC / coags / fibrinogen / cross-match; consider transfusion; escalate to OB / anaesthesia; tranexamic acid within 3 h
≥ 1500 mL or MTP trigger
Activate the obstetric MTP (1:1:1); intrauterine balloon tamponade; OR / interventional radiology (uterine artery embolisation, B-Lynch, uterine artery ligation, hysterectomy); ICU

items: Tone (80%) — uterine atony: fundal massage, bimanual compression, empty the bladder, uterotonics.
Trauma (10%) — cervical / vaginal / perineal lacerations, haematoma, uterine rupture or inversion: inspect and repair; reduce an inversion immediately (uterine relaxant then replace).
Tissue (9%) — retained placenta or products: manual removal, curettage; check the placenta is complete.
Thrombin (1%) — coagulopathy (DIC, dilutional, inherited, anticoagulant): FFP, cryoprecipitate / fibrinogen, platelets, TXA; treat the underlying trigger (abruption, AFE, sepsis, prolonged PPH).

rows: Oxytocin (1st-line)
20–40 units per litre at 250–500 mL/hr, OR 10 units IM
NEVER a rapid IV bolus (hypotension, arrhythmia, arrest). Infusion is standard.
Tranexamic acid
1 g IV over 10 min, within 3 h of delivery; repeat 1 g if still bleeding at 30 min
WOMAN trial: reduces death from bleeding. Giving it after 3 h is not beneficial.
Methylergonovine
0.2 mg IM, may repeat q2–4 h
CONTRAINDICATED in hypertension / preeclampsia (hypertensive crisis, stroke). Avoid IV.
Carboprost (15-methyl PGF2α, Hemabate)
0.25 mg IM q15 min, max 8 doses
CONTRAINDICATED in asthma (bronchospasm). Also causes vomiting / diarrhoea / fever.
Misoprostol (2nd-line)
600–1000 mcg PR / SL / buccal
Use where oxytocin is unavailable or as an adjunct. Shivering and pyrexia are common.

body.text: Ask 'asthma or hypertension?' BEFORE reaching for the second-line uterotonic — methylergonovine and carboprost are contraindicated in exactly those two conditions. Intrauterine balloon tamponade (Bakri or a Foley) controls > 80% of PPH unresponsive to uterotonics, confirms the uterus as the source, and buys time before surgery — use it early. Manual aortic compression is a bridge in extremis.

buildNote: Tier 1. Complements emergency-drugs-pregnancy (the same uterotonic doses in a drug-first layout). B-Lynch / uterine compression sutures and REBOA in PPH are surgical detail.
